messages:
maria: quick alert — partner delivered an S3 archive that contains a KMS-encrypted payload field that looks like a wrapped service key. object: s3://partner-archives/tidebridge/2026-04-02/db-dump.enc
maria: sample prefix (redacted): `CiID4F...==` — matches our KMS wrapped blob pattern
kevin: which partner infra path wrote that? could be from their side only but assume worst-case until we confirm.
maria: partner: tidebridge. pipeline: partner-push -> http-ingest -> s3-archive. they said they forward raw DB exports for debugging.
samir: triage plan (short): pause ingestion, request immediate object deletion + signed audit log, suspend partner cross-project IAM bindings, run a controlled unwrap, hunt for the SA email across Vault/audit logs, and rotate any implicated creds.
oncall: incident INC-2026-2 created and paging sec oncall. (reacted :rotating_light:)
vault-bot: sensitive-handling checklist attached to INC-2026-2; rewrap/rotate templates available.
kevin: ask partner to confirm whether they ran a local decrypt prior to forwarding. if yes, their side likely exposed plaintext. require them to rotate and furnish deletion proof (CloudTrail entry or SES receipt).
maria: i already DM'd partner-sec; they're coordinating and claim they never decrypted. asked for object id + delete proof.
samir: immediate ops commands i'm running / recommend:
```
# show kms decrypt attempts in last 48h
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/kms --filter-pattern "Decrypt" --start-time $(($(date +%s)-172800))000
# list s3 object access events
aws s3api list-objects --bucket partner-archives --prefix tidebridge/2026-04-02
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:s3:::partner-archives/partner-archives/tidebridge/2026-04-02/db-dump.enc
```
(kevin: copied to INC-2026-2)
kevin: RBAC change: removing kms:Decrypt from the log-forwarder role in our org for the partner SA and adding a conditional deny where possible. also add alert on any decrypt attempts from partner IP ranges.
maria: controlled unwrap plan: samir to decrypt in an isolated subnet VM with no internet, no keys cached, and with two approvers present (kevin + oncall). record only a SHA256 of plaintext and high-level classification (contains user_emails, api_keys, tokens, etc.). no secret material to be posted in chat.
samir: ack. provisioning locked runner now. ETA ~45m. will produce metadata and SHA256 only.
oncall: suspended partner cross-project IAM binding and rotated the temporary ingestion SA keys. will keep a hold until partner provides deletion proof.
vault-bot: scheduled automated search for partner SA email across Vault audit logs for last 7 days.
kevin: also run a fast grep for `partner_service_account@` in git history and CI logs — reduce blast radius.
maria: timeline:
- T+00:00 discovered encrypted blob and opened INC-2026-2 (maria)
- T+00:08 asked partner to delete + provide deletion proof (maria)
- T+00:12 suspended cross-project binding + rotated ingest SA keys (oncall)
- T+00:50 samir to complete controlled unwrap and post classification summary (samir)
- T+02:00 rewrap/rotate keys & reingest policy changes (infra)
- T+24:00 postmortem + RBAC hardening (sec)
maria: tagging INC-2026-2 as P1 for tracking. update ticket with each step. i'll handle partner comms and legal if they confirm plaintext exposure. :white_check_mark:
samir: starting unwrap now in isolated env; will post non-sensitive summary and SHA256 once complete.
